_about: Ablation: the same literary-weighted corpus as configs/bpe-64k.json, plus CC-100 Bengali (bntok.corpus.stream_cc100, cc100_general_web) as a bulk general-web supplement. Weights are normalised over all five sources by bntok.corpus.build_configured_corpus, so they need not sum to 1. Trained on both the v1 (BengaliTokenizer) and v2 (BMBT) architectures for a direct before/after comparison of adding CC-100, isolated from the architecture comparison itself. Neither run replaces the shipped artifacts/bn-bpe-64k or artifacts/bmbt-64k; see artifacts/bn-bpe-64k-cc100 and artifacts/bmbt-64k-cc100.
